source_book: Sri Chaitanya — IPE STUDY MATERIAL for Jr. Students, Chemistry (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring; stems restated in our own wording, no solution content by policy. Numbering runs continuously 1–44: VSAQ 1–25 (25 printed numbers, 38 entries after sub-part splitting), SAQ 26–41 (16 printed numbers, 32 entries), LAQ 42–44 (3 printed numbers, 5 entries), plus INTEXT SOLVED PROBLEMS 4.1–4.15 (15 printed labels, 20 entries) = 95 entries. No exam-year citations are printed anywhere in this chapter. Scan page 42 (printed 44) is cropped at the left margin (the number of SAQ 30 shows as '0.' and the footer as '4'), and the footer of scan page 46 (printed 48) is cropped to '8'; every other number and star is readable. The answers to 35(a) and 36(a) say 'Refer LAQ Q.1' and 'Refer LAQ Q.4', but the LAQ section of this chapter holds only questions 42–44, so both cross-references are dangling.

questions.stem: How many moles of glucose are present in 540 g of glucose?

questions.notes: PRINTED DEFECT in the working, not the question: the book's answer writes 'Molecular weight = 90' and computes 90/14 = 5, which is arithmetically wrong, although the stated datum 70 g/mol also gives n = 5 and the same final formula. The stem keeps 70 g/mol as printed in the question.
